traps: backend_linux.go and backend_windows.go carry no //go:build line: the _linux and _windows file-name suffixes are the constraint
on any one platform exactly one backend() exists; an indexer that loads every file sees three definitions of the same function
store/gen.go says package main inside package store's directory: the ignore tag keeps it out of every build, it is not a second package
open_test.go and integration_test.go declare package store_test, an external test package beside store; it is not a separate directory or unit
integration_test.go only builds with -tags integration: the default go test ./... does not compile TestOpenTwice
ignore and integration are both build tags, but only integration selects a build variant; ignore means never
